picker.none: No locations yet. Build the tree in Organisation → Locations.
picker.noPlaces: No places in this branch yet. Add sites, floors or zones in Organisation → Locations.
picker.noGroups: No group locations yet. Add Headquarters or regions in Organisation → Locations.

roleNotes.group: It sits above {{branch}}: its locations group branches, like a head office or a region, and have no devices or timezone of their own.
roleNotes.branch: This is the level of your branches: each one keeps its timezone, calendar, devices and data access.
roleNotes.place: It sits below {{branch}}: its locations are places inside a branch, like a site, a floor or a zone.

levels.title: Levels
levels.description: How your organisation is arranged, from the top down. Levels above {{branch}} group branches; levels below it are places inside a branch.
levels.branchLevelKept: {{name}} is your operating unit: it can be renamed, not deleted.
levels.inUse_one: {{count}} location uses this level (archived ones count too). Give it another level first.
levels.inUse_other: {{count}} locations use this level (archived ones count too). Give them another level first.
levels.maxReached: An organisation has at most {{max}} levels.
levels.scopedHint: Only members with access to every branch can change the levels. You can manage the places inside your branches below.
levels.deleteHint: The levels below it move up one place.

simple.title: One level for now: {{branch}}
simple.body: Every branch sits at the top of the tree. Many organisations describe their estate as a hierarchy, for example:
simple.next: Add a level above {{branch}} to group branches under a head office or regions, or below it for the sites, floors and zones inside a branch — or start from a template.
simple.askAdmin: An administrator with access to every branch can set up the levels.

levelDialog.addHint: Name the level the way your organisation does; the name can be changed at any time.
levelDialog.renameHint: The name appears in every location screen, picker and filter.
levelDialog.name: Name (English)

templates.title: Use a template
templates.description: A template replaces your levels with a common structure in one step. Every name can be changed afterwards, in English and Arabic.
templates.label: Templates
templates.blocked: Templates replace the whole list of levels, so they can only be applied while there is no group or place location (archived ones included). Rename, add or delete levels one by one instead.
templates.conflict: The template was not applied: the organisation now has group or place locations. Rename, add or delete levels one by one instead.

SIMPLE.title: Simple
SIMPLE.description: One level: your branches, as they are today. No grouping and no places inside branches.

CORPORATE.title: Corporate
CORPORATE.description: A head office above the branches, with sites, floors and zones inside each branch.

REGIONAL.title: Regional
REGIONAL.description: A head office and regions above the branches, with sites, floors and zones inside each branch.

RETAIL.title: Retail
RETAIL.description: Stores grouped by region, with sections inside each store.

FACILITIES.title: Facilities
FACILITIES.description: Sites with buildings, floors and zones — the spatial structure of building information models.

MANUFACTURING.title: Manufacturing
MANUFACTURING.description: Plant sites with areas, production lines and work stations — the equipment hierarchy of manufacturing systems.

HEALTHCARE.title: Healthcare
HEALTHCARE.description: Hospitals with buildings, floors and wards.

EDUCATION.title: Education
EDUCATION.description: Campuses with buildings, floors and rooms.

SECURITY_SERVICES.title: Security services
SECURITY_SERVICES.description: Client sites grouped by region, with guard posts at each site.

tree.title: Location tree
tree.description: Your groups, branches and the places inside them. Employee and device counts include everything below a location.
tree.label: Locations
tree.emptyHint: Each branch appears here as soon as it is created under Organisation → Branches.

locationDialog.addHint: The level decides what the location is; only the levels that may sit here are offered.
locationDialog.editHint: To put the location somewhere else in the tree, use Move.
locationDialog.levelHint: Levels may be skipped, e.g. floors directly in a branch without a site.
locationDialog.codeHint: Left empty, it is made from the name.
locationDialog.codeEditHint: Unique among the locations next to it.
locationDialog.codeInvalid: Use letters, digits, - _ or . and start with a letter or a digit.
locationDialog.codeTaken: A location next to it already has this code.
locationDialog.name: Name (English)
locationDialog.pointHint: Optional: the latitude and the longitude of the location — give both or neither.
locationDialog.pointBoth: Give both the latitude and the longitude, or neither.

move.title: Move {{name}}
move.placeHint: Choose the group location it belongs to, or clear the field to put it at the top level.
move.noTargets: There is no other location this one can go under.
move.crossBranch: This puts it in another branch. That only works while no device, employee, geofence, coverage target or policy refers to it or to anything below it.
move.refused: The move was refused: a device, an employee, a geofence, a coverage target or a policy still refers to this place or to a place below it. Move those first, or keep the place in its branch.

archive.title: Archive {{name}}?
archive.description: Archived locations disappear from pickers and filters and can be restored. A location cannot be archived while active locations, devices, employees or geofences are in it.
archive.inUse: {{name}} is still in use: {{items}}. Move or archive them first.

branchPlacement.label: Part of
branchPlacement.hint: The group location this branch belongs to, such as a head office or a region. Empty = the top level.
branchPlacement.scoped: Only members with access to every branch can change where a branch sits.
